newsitem.title: USA: Argentina - IMF's Camdessus backs letter of intent.
newsitem.headline: Argentina - IMF's Camdessus backs letter of intent.

text.p: International Monetary Fund Managing Director Michel Camdessus will recommend the approval of Argentina's letter of intent for their standby economic program when the IMF board meets at the end of October, Argentine Economy Secretary Carlos Rodriguez said Thursday.
"This is standard procedure. The managing director's endorsement is usually a sign that things will go well at the baord," Rodriguez told Reuters.
Rodriguez dismissed as incorrect Argentine agency reports Wednesday night which said the IMF had approved a waiver for the missed economic targets for the first half of 1996.
That waiver is part of the letter of intent that the IMF board would consider around October 30, Rodriguez added.

The IMF's staff had expressed support for Argentina's new economic program on Sept 13. Amongst changes to the original goals, Argentina will propose to meet a $6 billion fiscal deficit for 1996 rather than a $2.5 billion shortfall it had originally committed itself to.
